verdict.line: You lose if she pokes you down with Lunge (Q) and Riposte-punishes your Thundering Smash (Q) before level 6; you win if you survive to your item spikes around level 9-12 and force the fight to go long.

brief.thesis: Fiora's Lunge (Q, 16-8s cd, resettable second dash) outranges your W (Frenzied Maul, 325 range) and wins short trades from levels 1-5, and her Riposte (W) directly punishes your main engage tool, Thundering Smash (Q), if you throw it into an active parry. Your actual win condition is range: Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range, 16s cd) can't be parried and lets you poke and shield through her aggression until your bruiser build and W-heal sustain take over around level 9-12. The 50% head-to-head winrate over 1449 games reflects a lane she wins early and you win late, not a lane either side dominates outright.

theirWindow.what: She'll bait your Thundering Smash (Q) into her active parry, negating the stun and taking a magic-damage reflection while her own AD is buffed; don't throw Q into this, poke with E instead.

yourWindow.when: Riposte (W) just spent or on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With her W down for 10-6s depending on rank she can't parry; this is when Thundering Smash (Q) actually lands clean. Commit then, follow with a second W (Frenzied Maul) cast on the same target for the bonus damage and heal, then finish with E for the slow and shield.

powerCurve.note: Free second Lunge dash punishes short trades
Blade Waltz spikes but your E offsets poke
Bruiser items and W-heal outscale her sustain
Full build and tankiness win extended skirmishes

start.why: The regen and mana sustain let you spam W (Frenzied Maul) and E (Sky Splitter) through her poke phase instead of having to back off low on resources.

boots.why: Flat damage reduction blunts her basic-attack-heavy trade pattern from Lunge (Q) and Burst of Speed (E) auto-resets.

core.why: Ability haste cycles Frenzied Maul (W) and Sky Splitter (E) faster so you have more windows to punish her Riposte downtime.
Cooldown refund off takedowns means more W casts for heal and more E uptime for poke across a skirmish.
Heal amp stacks with Frenzied Maul's self-heal to directly outpace her Duelist passive regen in extended trades.

situational.when: she's building crit or lifesteal to out-sustain your trades
you're losing the early poke war to Lunge (Q) and need cheap health and regen to reach level 6
the lane has gone even and you need wave clear or chase speed instead of more tank stats

runes.keystoneWhy: The ramping attack speed rewards winning the long trade, stacking with your passive's attack-speed buildup and spam-casting Frenzied Maul (W), rather than trying to win a single short burst exchange where her Riposte-buffed AD wins.

summoners.why: Ignite's healing reduction is what actually lets a landed Thundering Smash (Q) stun convert into a kill instead of a trade, since it cuts through her Duelist passive sustain. It's also the highest win-rate and most-picked combo in this matchup (50.9% WR, 72.9% pick).

playing.title: Trade with E, not Q
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range, 16s cd) can't be parried the way a basic-attack engage can, so it's your safe poke tool while you wait out her cooldowns.

playing.title: Never Q into an up Riposte
playing.detail: Check her W cooldown before charging in with Thundering Smash (Q); if Riposte is available she will parry your stunning attack and punish you for it, exactly as OP.GG's own matchup note warns.

playing.title: Bait her second Lunge charge
playing.detail: Fiora gets a free second Lunge (Q) dash shortly after the first; let her spend both before you commit, since she's locked out for the full 16-8s cooldown afterward.

playing.title: Double-tap W before any all-in
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul (W, 5s cd) marks on the first hit and heals you on the recast; land it twice around your stun to offset her passive regen instead of trading once and backing off.

playing.title: Stand in your own E for the shield
playing.detail: Sky Splitter grants you a shield if you're inside its blast; drop it under yourself right as she pops Burst of Speed (E) or double-Lunges to blunt her burst.

playing.title: Save R to force the fight, not to chase
playing.detail: Stormbringer (R, 160-110s cd) disables nearby towers on landing, so use it to commit her to an unfavorable fight near her own tower rather than chasing a speed-buffed Fiora who's already landed Blade Waltz (R).

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 50% head-to-head winrate over 1449 games are measured OP.GG data from the current patch (16.19.1); the lane-phase reasoning, cooldown interactions, and trade windows are my own tactical read, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Always be aware of Fiora’s Riposte (W) before charging in using [Q]. Be careful of your Vitals when farming lane, and use [E] to contest lane while waiting for a chance to kill her.
